effects.description: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] ➃ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): Set up to 1 of your {Supernovas} or {Straw Hat Crew} type Character cards with a cost of 5 or less as active. It gains +1000 power during this turn.
conditions: You haven't used this effect yet this turn
You have at least 1 {Supernovas} or {Straw Hat Crew} Character with a cost of 5 or less on your field
You have 4 active DON!! cards you can rest
steps: Rest 4 DON!! cards to activate this effect
Choose up to 1 {Supernovas} or {Straw Hat Crew} Character with a cost of 5 or less
That Character gains +1000 power during this turn
notes: You must activate this effect yourself during your Main Phase
You can choose not to target any Character
The +1000 power bonus ends after this turn
